'''Apple soup''' is a soup prepared using [[apple]]s as a primary ingredient. The apples can be [[purée]]d, sliced, or boiled and used whole.<ref name="Rumble 2009"/> Onions, carrots, [[parsnip]] and pumpkin are used in some preparations.<ref name="Phillips 2014"/><ref name="Atlas 2009"/><ref name="Johnson Hirsheimer 2003"/><ref name="Peterson 2009"/> Some recipes use chicken or vegetable [[broth]] or [[stock (food)|stock]], while some others use water or [[apple cider]].<ref name="Yonan 2015"/> Additional ingredients can be added according to taste, such as cinnamon, lemon juice, sugar, [[ginger]], [[curry]] powder, salt and pepper.<ref name="Rumble 2009"/><ref name="Yonan 2015"/> It is sometimes served as an [[appetizer]].<ref name="Ojakangas 2013"/>

Apple soup has been used as a dish to feed the sick, as occurred circa the early 1900s in the United States.<ref name="Roper 1914"/>
